agent_notes: SAGE University Indore is government-listed in all six supplied NIRF 2025 category pages; each matching row shows Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification produced the exact managed-proxy self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure only after confirming the expected official hostnames.
The official homepage, about page and contact page establish the Indore campus at Kailod Kartal, Rau Bypass Road, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452020.

The official site exposes 119 course pages with programme names and course-page metadata, plus a full-time Ph.D. page. The sitemap and institute-page inventories are inconsistent; five linked official course URLs are blank templates. The admissions portal exposes a generic Certificate Programs selector, but no named certificate catalogue was established. Catalogue is therefore partial and requires manual review; no unsupported blank-template or unnamed certificate programme was imported.
Pharmacy mappings use the career tree node slug bpharm whose stored label is Medical Updated; this is a career-tree label issue, not an institution-page naming change.
Course eligibility strings are transcribed from the official course-page Eligibility sections; fields are null where the official page did not explicitly provide the fact.
